title: HyperZip: Efficient Data Compression through Personalized Diffusion LLMs with Hypernetworks
abstract: arXiv:2609.36357v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for lossless data compression, but existing approaches are constrained by the high computational cost and low throughput of autoregressive decoding. We propose HyperZip, an efficient and scalable LLM-based compression framework that leverages diffusion-based LLMs (dLLMs) with Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) to accelerate LLM-based data compression processes. We identify a trade-off in diffusion-based compression, where increasing decoding throughput degrades the compression rate. To mitigate this trade-off, HyperZip employs a hypernetwork to generate data-specific updates from a context representation, adapting the dLLM to the target data without costly fine-tuning, resulting in a low compression rate and high throughput. Extensive experiments show that HyperZip achieves a superior trade-off between compression rate and speed compared with state-of-the-art baselines.

translated_title: HyperZip：基于超网络个性化扩散大语言模型的高效数据压缩
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在无损数据压缩方面展现出巨大潜力，但现有方法受限于自回归解码的高计算成本和低吞吐量。我们提出HyperZip，一个高效且可扩展的基于LLM的压缩框架，利用扩散式大语言模型结合多词元预测（MTP）来加速基于LLM的数据压缩过程。我们识别出基于扩散的压缩中存在的一个权衡问题：提高解码吞吐量会导致压缩率下降。为缓解这一权衡，HyperZip采用超网络从上下文表示中生成针对特定数据的更新，无需昂贵的微调即可将扩散大语言模型适配到目标数据，从而实现较低的压缩率和较高的吞吐量。大量实验表明，与最先进的基线方法相比，HyperZip在压缩率和速度之间实现了更优的权衡。
tldr: HyperZip利用超网络从上下文表示生成数据特定更新，无需昂贵微调即可个性化扩散式大语言模型，从而缓解了压缩率与解码吞吐量之间的权衡，实现了高效的无损数据压缩。
en_tdlr: HyperZip leverages a hypernetwork to generate data-specific updates that personalize diffusion LLMs without costly fine-tuning, mitigating the trade-off between compression rate and decoding throughput for efficient lossless data compression.
